// FAQ with a contact card: the heading and a "still have questions" card on the left (it stays in view // while the questions scroll on wide screens), the accordion on the right. On phones the card comes after // the heading and before the questions. import { Clock, Mail } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/accordion" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" const FAQS = [ ["Is Orbit really free for three clients?", "Yes. The Free plan has no time limit and no card on file. You only pay when you add a fourth client or want the Studio features."], ["What does it cost to get paid?", "Card payments cost 2.9% + 30¢ and bank transfers 0.8%, capped at $5. Fees are shown on every invoice before you send it, and you can pass them on to the client."], ["Will my clients need an account?", "No. They get an email with a link to the invoice and pay in a minute. They can come back to the same link to download receipts."], ["Can reminders really sound like me?", "You write the first reminder, or pick a tone, and Orbit keeps that voice for the others. You can read every reminder before it goes out."], ["Can I import my clients and old invoices?", "Yes. Import a CSV from your spreadsheet or your old tool, and Orbit keeps the invoice numbers going from where you left off."], ["Can I cancel any time?", "Yes. Cancel from settings and you drop to the Free plan at the end of the period.
